items.name: Deer Shit
items.description: Grants Expeditious Retreat buff for 4d4 minutes. Leaves a bad taste in the mouth.

items.name: Scrap Horn
items.description:
This "horn" is more of a metal trumpet without the instrument bit. It is fashioned from re-purposed armor plates, many of which still have bullet/arrow holes and dents from battle. 
The item is heavily enchanted by months of ritual prayer. The prayers focused on found-family unity and the device now provides several benefits.
All effects require yelling into the megaphone.
1) Communal buff-spells have their duration doubled and affect twice as many targets. This includes communal cure-spells.

items.name: Druid's Vestment
items.description:
Description
This light garment is worn over normal clothing or armor. Most such vestments are green, embroidered with elaborate plant or animal motifs. When this item is worn by a character with the wild shape ability, the character can use that ability one additional time each day.
Base Item: 
RequirementsCraft Wondrous Item, polymorph or wild shape ability
Source: Ultimate Equipment

items.name: Tooth Necklace
items.description: Made from various animals & peoples teeth, this enchanted necklace is often worn by the Earthendottrs of Numeria.

items.name: Patchwork Skin Cloak +2
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
